Package edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata

Class StripChartCurve

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata.ACurve
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata.StripChartCurve
public class StripChartCurve extends ACurve
Backing data model for a strip chart / time-series plot.

This class periodically samples a provided Evaluator and appends (t, y) points into bounded X and Y columns. When capacity is reached, the oldest samples are dropped ("scrolls off the left").

Threading

Sampling runs on a background scheduler thread. To preserve the ACurve contract that notifications occur on the Swing Event Dispatch Thread (EDT), this class uses a lock-free staging queue:

  • The background sampler thread computes samples and enqueues them.
  • An EDT drain pass applies samples in bounded batches under ACurve.lock.
  • A single consolidated ACurve.markDataChanged() is fired per batch (EDT-only).

The optional setOnSample(Runnable) callback, if provided, is invoked on the EDT after each drain pass. This is a convenient place to call repaint() safely.

    • setCapacity

      public void setCapacity(int capacity)
      Set the capacity (max samples retained). If the current size exceeds the new capacity, oldest samples are dropped immediately.

      If called off the EDT, this method schedules the capacity enforcement on the EDT to keep column mutation and notifications Swing-correct.

      Parameters:
      capacity - must be >= 2

    • start

      public void start()
      Start sampling. Safe to call multiple times; subsequent calls do nothing if already running.

    • stop

      public void stop()
      Stop sampling. Safe to call multiple times.

      This cancels the scheduled task but keeps the scheduler alive so you can start() again.

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Permanently shut down this StripChartCurve (cannot be restarted). Use when the owning plot is being disposed.

    • clearData

      public void clearData()
      Clear all retained samples.

      Thread-safe: if called off-EDT, schedules the clear on the EDT. Pending queued samples are also discarded so the curve becomes truly empty.

      Specified by:
      clearData in class ACurve

    • add

      public void add(double tms, double y)
      Add an explicit sample (t, y) to this strip chart.

      Thread-safe: may be called from any thread. Off-EDT calls enqueue and schedule a coalesced EDT drain. Notifications remain EDT-only per ACurve.

      Parameters:
      tms - time value (typically ms since start)
      y - sample value
